scope: Private streaming downloads and anonymous-session form preservation

implementation.download: S3 stream to Web Streams with an explicit 64 KiB byte queue; no whole-file collector in source/export HTTP downloads
implementation.protocol: GET/HEAD, exact length, validators, single byte ranges, If-Range, 416 and no-store
implementation.limits: 30 second upstream header timeout, 15 minute upstream transfer deadline, cancellation aborts the SDK request
implementation.authorization: Owner, completion/quarantine and teacher-approval checks precede both metadata and byte responses
implementation.signup: Keep the existing anonymous auth form mounted during subsequent session refreshes; otherwise signup loses its OTP step
implementation.ci: Explicit verification-enabled primary integration runtime plus existing no-SMTP runtime; Lite conflict test now resolves the comparison before expecting editable fields

evidence.unit: 105 passed, including five real-SDK tests against an isolated loopback S3 fixture
evidence.streamFixture: 32 MiB producer does not finish while the consumer is paused; reader cancellation closes the unfinished HTTP response; incoming abort and stalled-body deadline also tested
evidence.chromium: 10 upload/download/release cases, one Lite import/edit/export case, one OTP case, five no-mail/session cases passed
evidence.webkit: Four cases passed: Lite import/edit/export and all three real-storage download/authorization cases
evidence.otpBeforeFix: Verification-enabled runtime reproduced return to login instead of code entry; the same real-Mailpit test passed after preserving the mounted form
evidence.build: Production Docker image built; lint, typecheck, source visibility, formatting and recognizable-secret scan passed
evidence.runtime: Local runtime restored to email verification disabled after temporary mail-mode tests

limitations: Upstream buffers and the HTTP stack exist in addition to the explicitly bounded Web Streams queue; this is not a global process-memory cap
Import and rendering still require size-limited whole-document buffers
Cloud gateway transfer limits and cancellation require staging verification after hosting is available
No public deployment, physical Windows 7 test, external email delivery or paid AI call was performed in this batch
GitHub CI must finish separately; local results do not claim a green remote run
